visualizations.title: New and Returning Visitors
visualizations.sqlQuery: SELECT SUM(etl_data_hourly.value) AS total, [etlDataTable] FROM etl_data_hourly JOIN metrics ON etl_data_hourly.metric_id = metrics.id JOIN person_types ON etl_data_hourly.person_type_id = person_types.id WHERE etl_data_hourly.stream_id IN ([streamIds]) AND etl_data_hourly.date BETWEEN [fromDate] AND [toDate] AND person_types.name != 'Staff' AND metrics.name = 'Unique' GROUP BY [groupByFormat] ORDER BY [groupByFormat];

visualizations.title: Mosque and Souq Visitors
visualizations.sqlQuery: SELECT SUM([etlDataTable].value) AS total, [selectFields] FROM [etlDataTable] JOIN demographics ON [etlDataTable].demographics_id = demographics.id JOIN genders ON demographics.gender_id = genders.id JOIN person_types ON [etlDataTable].person_type_id = person_types.id WHERE [etlDataTable].stream_id IN ([streamIds]) AND [etlDataTable].date BETWEEN [fromDate] AND [toDate] AND person_types.name != 'Staff' AND genders.gender = 'Male' GROUP BY [groupByFormat] ORDER BY [groupByFormat];

visualizations.title: Happy and Unhappy Visitors
visualizations.sqlQuery: SELECT SUM([etlDataTable].value) AS total, [selectFields] FROM [etlDataTable] JOIN streams ON [etlDataTable].stream_id = streams.id JOIN person_types ON [etlDataTable].person_type_id = person_types.id WHERE [etlDataTable].stream_id IN ([streamIds]) AND [etlDataTable].date BETWEEN [fromDate] AND [toDate] AND person_types.name != 'Staff' AND streams.name LIKE '%Mosque%' GROUP BY [groupByFormat] ORDER BY [groupByFormat];

visualizations.title: Average Peak Engagement
visualizations.sqlQuery: SELECT streams.name, WEEK(etl.date) AS week_number, DAYOFWEEK(etl.date) AS day_of_week, HOUR(etl.date) AS hour, SUM(etl.value) AS total_value, ROUND(AVG(SUM(etl.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY streams.name, DAYOFWEEK(etl.date)), 0) AS average_total_value FROM etl_data_hourly AS etl JOIN streams ON etl.stream_id = streams.id JOIN person_types ON etl.person_type_id = person_types.id WHERE person_types.name != 'Staff' AND etl.stream_id IN ([streamIds]) AND etl.date BETWEEN [startDate] AND [endDate] GROUP BY streams.name, WEEK(etl.date), DAYOFWEEK(etl.date), HOUR(etl.date) ORDER BY week_number ASC, day_of_week ASC, hour ASC;

visualizations.title: Footfall
visualizations.sqlQuery: SELECT streams.name, [selectFields], SUM(etl.value) AS total_value FROM [etlDataTable] AS etl JOIN streams ON etl.stream_id = streams.id JOIN person_types ON etl.person_type_id = person_types.id WHERE person_types.name != 'Staff' AND etl.stream_id IN ([streamIds]) AND etl.date BETWEEN '[startDate] 00:00:00' AND '[endDate] 23:59:59' GROUP BY streams.id, [groupByFormat], streams.name ORDER BY [groupByFormat];

visualizations.sqlQuery: SELECT streams.name, [selectFields], SUM(etl.value) AS total_value FROM [etlDataTable] AS etl JOIN streams ON etl.stream_id = streams.id JOIN person_types ON etl.person_type_id = person_types.id WHERE etl.stream_id IN ([streamIds]) AND person_types.name = 'staff' AND etl.date BETWEEN '[startDate]' AND '[endDate]' GROUP BY streams.id, [groupByFormat], streams.name ORDER BY [groupByFormat];
